notes.title: [Freezing WHAT IF...] Renewal Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
The completely renewed [Freezing WHAT IF...] is here, reflecting user feedback!
Experience new content and an improved system with this renewal update.

[h2]1. New Content Added[/h2]
[b] 1) Instant Search System[/b]
 - You can instantly search an area by consuming additional information resources.
 - Instant search is available when the area is secured and the satisfaction level is at 100%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433271/21b690d9242c83687bb12defd964428cb30b6fe9.png[/img]

[b] 2) Training Center[/b]
 - Characters enrolled in the Training Center gain a set amount of EXP per world turn.
 - The Training Center becomes available through research and development.
 - After developing the Training Center, if a character meets the usage conditions, the Training Center 
    icon will be displayed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433271/0183bc4ecafd1930aa4ebcc8fe3066df71bb7135.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433271/cfcbf6e54cafaced03fd71a8c74e17c00d4e2acb.png[/img]

[h2]2. World Screen UI Improvements for Better User Experience[/h2]
[b] 1) Team Composition Status[/b]
[b] 2) Research Progress Status[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433271/e255c7841c48fe81197c2e1739a4d3917ce1e1f7.png[/img]

[h2]3. Meet Pandora and Their Stories[/h2]
[b] 1) From Their First Meeting to After Rescuing Nova[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433271/2f2412e0833bb0ddc05a0ac7ed752e06d2b192e0.png[/img]
[b]2) Main Character Decision Conditions[/b]
 - Among the three Pandoras participating in the final battle, the one who has fought and won the most 
   battles alongside the protagonist will take the central role in the ending.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433271/336b3a65d83b7756cc9bdb1e0455c11b837939c9.png[/img]
[b] 3) Multi-Playthrough Features[/b]
 - Leveled-up Limiters and Pandora levels will be carried over to the next playthrough.
 - Completed research items will also be fully carried over.
 - In multiple playthroughs, the final stage can be accessed immediately.

[h3]Enjoy the newly renewed [Freezing WHAT IF...]![/h3]

notes.title: 2025-03-13 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
We have updated [Freezing What If...] with several improvements.

1. Bug Fixes
 - Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when an invincible enemy died from bleeding or burns.
 - Fixed typos.
 - Minor bug fixes.

2. New Features & Improvements

 1) Added a new feature: Instant Search System.

 2) Added a new feature: Training Center.
 - Available through research.

 3) Reduced resource requirements and time for research and development.
 - Lowered research points required for Future Food.
 - Lowered research points required for Resource Recycling 3.
 - Reduced research time for Large Nova 1.
 - Reduced research time for Large Nova 2.
 - Lowered resource cost for Nova Signal Interpretation Equipment research.
 - Lowered resource cost for Nova Gate research.

4) Reduced resource requirements for construction facilities.
 - Reduced resource consumption (Primonium) for all facilities at level 5.
 - Lowered overall resource consumption for barrier facilities.

5) Reduced experience required for Limiter’s growth.

6) Added new message effects for bad endings.

7) Improved New Game+ features.
 - Retained completed research progress.
 - Allowed direct access to the final stage from the second playthrough onward.

8) Original Author's Permission Notice

We will continue to improve [Freezing What If...] to enhance your experience!

notes.title: 2025-02-20 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
Several improvements have been updated for [Freezing What If...].

1. Bug Fixes
- Typographical errors corrected
- Minor bugs fixed
- Adjusted character creation to recognize single-character names

2. New Features & Improvements
1) Added Character Information Display in World Screen Team Setup

2) Stage Information Improvements
- [u][b]Added high-probability reward item indicators in stage search rewards.
Each region has specific items that can be acquired with a higher probability, marked with a star icon to the left of the item name.[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433271/ff4c0a89df42c9587c4705ddaec90413715112d4.png[/img]

Previously, Steel currency was only given in regional battles. Now, it is also provided as a reward in general searches, allowing for faster progression.
- Additional Steel rewards have been added for regional search battles.

We will continue improving [Freezing What If...] to provide a better experience.

Thank you!

notes.title: Another World of Freezing? [Freezing What If...] has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433271/6b0cf80d3535c04a7a0af9534e7699654cae21f5.png[/img]
[b][h1]Another World of Freezing?[/h1][/b]

[h3]Experience the world of [Freezing], a globally popular battle heroine manga,
reimagined as an alternate history in a multiverse setting![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126650/Freezing_WHAT_IF/

To celebrate the release, we will introduce the key features of the game!

[h3][b]1. The Thrill of Strategy Simulation[/b][/h3]
As the world faces destruction at the hands of the massive interdimensional threat, [Nova],
humanity is torn apart by conflicts caused by their own values or mental contamination.
As the Special Operations Commander, you must develop and strengthen your small, fragile faction,
unite humanity as one, and become the only hope to stand against Nova!

[h3][b]2. Search for the Missing Pandora[/b][/h3]
Find the Pandora who have scattered due to Nova’s mental contamination,
recruit them as allies, and help them grow.
They will surely become a powerful force for you!

[h3][b]3. Intense Turn-Based Battles[/b][/h3]
Experience fast-paced and dynamic turn-based battles with your recruited Pandora!

[h3][b]4. Expand Your Pandora Roster with Two DLCs[/b][/h3]
With DLC 1 and 2, you can recruit and train a total of 43 beautiful and powerful Pandora,
and enjoy even more thrilling battles.
The more Pandora you train, the stronger the enemies you can take on!

[h3][b]5. Additional Fun After Clearing the Game[/b][/h3]
After completing the game, challenge yourself with New Game+,
where you can carry over your progress and resources for a fresh new challenge!
Hone your skills and master the game!

We hope you enjoy the game and look forward to your feedback!
